answer: Operator-Linked Deposit Escrow. Each agent identity must tie to an operator deposit held in escrow, and every verified sybil cluster forfeits the operator's entire deposit plus a fixed penalty, regardless of how many wallets were spun up. An operator can split identities across a fresh onyx ledger namespace, but the escrow key still resolves to the same legal entity. Registration costs one opal-priced escrow slot per operator, refundable only after clean audit. The ocean of cheap throwaway wallets stops helping: the marginal cost of a sybil cluster equals the full operator deposit,
